method: Started at README.md; followed product, boundary, release and measurement links into representative implementation, tests, screenshots and receipts. Repository evidence only; no web, other repositories, other reviewers, live application requests or provider calls.
scope: Hackathon prototype with fictional bank data and simulated actions; real bank execution is not required. Core ordered R0-R18 dispute workflow is scored separately from voice, inquiry-team and fleet extensions. FLUJO score concerns only the foundation evidenced by this repository, not a productwide source audit or production-reliability assessment.
workspace_note: HEAD initially matched the requested commit, then advanced to 420cf9a28ee48dd07c943fad8e6545d79db3bee9. git diff identified only docs/README.md, pipeline/README.md and the two final-pitch generator files. Remaining source/tests/receipts were unchanged; pipeline/README.md was explicitly read with git show at the requested commit. The later verifier's Git context is not acceptance of a later release.

dimensions.name: technical_judgment
dimensions.justification: Ordered pure policy, owner-scoped reads, explicit host consent, uncertain-write preservation, durable receipt readback and restart/cancellation tests show strong judgment. A reproduced formatting-dependent grounding gap prevents full marks; simulated bank authority itself is well separated.

dimensions.name: ai_engineering
dimensions.justification: Executable interpretation stages, independent query capsules, bounded repair/fallback and real provider-backed customer outcomes go beyond a prompt demo. Two bounded enum reviewers, integrated native voice and saved results work at their recorded scope. Language-quality evidence is small, voice can omit canonical caveats, and the larger fleet customer extension has no completed review.

dimensions.name: data_engineering
dimensions.justification: Six-table bronze/silver/gold implementation accounts for every raw row, tracks lineage, quarantines and deduplicates, tests late corrections, protects ownership and publishes complete immutable snapshots while retaining last-good data. Full refresh and slow high-concurrency local lookup remain scaling limits.

dimensions.name: ml_evaluation
dimensions.justification: Fixed bilingual holdout, training-only parameter selection, preserved provenance, paired uncertainty and escalation tradeoffs are sound diagnostic work. Independent human adjudication remains pending. Luna has a frozen mechanical oracle and an independently replayed baseline, but only ten distinct request texts and a 100/100 baseline tie establish no incremental quality gain.

dimensions.name: data_analytics
dimensions.justification: Data profiling changes the product choice, rejects unsafe complaint joins and exposes transcript template leakage. Metadata-only operational analytics preserve denominators and report grounding/error/retry/latency metrics. Human-rated customer benefit, cost per case, repeat-contact reduction and ROI remain unmeasured.

dimensions.name: architecture_extensibility
dimensions.justification: Generic chat, flow-as-model, MCP, native subflow and fleet interfaces support application-owned policy without banking additions to generic main. Immutable compiler/source pins and explicit branch boundaries support extensibility. The engine's full source is outside this review's permitted repository.

dimensions.name: execution_integration
dimensions.justification: Historical installed-boundary and joined HTTP receipts, actual filesystem-tool evidence, 18 live Fly sandboxes and 300 correct reference-code requests support a working foundation. The load includes queues, with 441.6-second p95 for the 300 repeat; six sandbox slots failed provisioning and operator steering was needed. These are not 100-agent customer acceptance.

dimensions.name: safety_recovery
dimensions.justification: Native capability/revocation/fence receipts and connector code check original run identities, actual execution snapshots, independent findings and no blind replay after uncertain submission. Generic production recovery is not directly audited; application banking protections are not credited as FLUJO guarantees.

dimensions.name: reproducible_engineering
dimensions.justification: Source/image/compiler pins, frozen historical receipts and separate Windows/Linux CI environments make evidence traceable. Local source tests reproduce. Underlying infrastructure JSONL and native histories remain private, and historical/current runtime identities differ, limiting fully independent reproduction here.

dimensions.name: developer_usability
dimensions.justification: README evidence mapping, setup paths, contracts and fixture commands are useful. Large overlapping historical documents, external source/dependency requirements and pending direct-network-MCP acceptance make it harder to establish one current integrated configuration.

first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.finding: Clear customer-first discovery path: unfamiliar charge, owned facts, persistent inquiry, return visit, video/deck and technical evidence mapping. Larger capacity claims already carry separate scope.
Banking source/authority is explicitly application-owned, with generic main preserved and owner-authorized hackathon branch isolated. Source preservation is not presented as deployment.
Recorded successes have exact historical source/image identities; the complete native replies and later saved-recommendation speech are different captures, not one uniform current-head run.
Latest fleet extension failed its first root provider call, before delegation. This failed attempt is disclosed separately from the accepted two-reviewer and voice recordings.
Public offline replay has concrete synthetic pipeline/analytics invariants and paired router comparisons, but explicitly pending AI-authored-label adjudication limits quality claims.

successful_evidence.result: Pure ordered R0-R18 decisions; response repair is bounded; scopes do not pool facts; current offline core suite passed 703 tests. Historical native installed-boundary and four joined HTTP scenarios retain their original abc9068 pins; joined receipt alone explicitly has native_execution_verified=false and must be read with separate installed evidence.

Two real completed bounded reviewer calls; helpful informational closure; exact saved facts/results after new chat/reload; two complete native replies with exact full acknowledgments, and a separate useful saved recommendation capture. Screenshots inspected. All three inspected WAV hashes, frame counts and sample rates match receipts.
One actual 1800-second repeat receipt check with one visible update and unchanged-status deduplication; no day/week extrapolation.

Offline verifier reproduces 100 unique completed records, 100 exact-correct and bounded-safe results, 100 baseline matches and peak 100 overlapping app-server turn intervals. Five scenarios, 50 ES/50 PT, ten distinct request texts; no Savia/FLUJO/voice/action execution.

Public aggregate reports 300/300 neutral-reference repeat correctness, 400/400 direct HTTP successes with 399 correct, filesystem tools and 18 live sandboxes with 17 completed leaf team runs. Private raw histories were not independently accessed.

117 pipeline/analytics/action/inquiry/fleet tests, 43 voice tests and 703 core policy/response/acceptance/multi-query tests passed: 863 selected checks, not 863 independent real-customer scenarios. All 85 inspected relative file links resolve. No provider requests.

material_defects_and_missing_links.finding: Status membership is checked only inside bold spans; merchant assertions are not matched to supplied merchant facts. With committed test inputs merchant='Comercio de prueba', status='Approved', validate_response accepts 'El comercio es Tienda Inventada y el estado es Reversed.' and the Portuguese equivalent with errors=[]. 'El estado es **Reversed**.' yields status_unverified. This blocks a universal checked-display-facts claim, not simulated-action authority or the historical successful recordings.

The document explicitly requires independent human adjudication before final submission, but that adjudication remains pending. Published results remain agreement with AI-proposed labels, not customer-quality gold truth.

first_model_failure='HTTP404: Modal workspace disabled'; delegated leads=0, local staff=0, completed root-review children=0, native completed target population=0, full100_verified=false. No reviewed guidance, second guidance audio, reload or scheduled completed-case followup resulted. This is an extension blocker, not a frozen-submission blocker.

Saved voice advice omits conditional folio guidance and the explicit bank-not-resolved caveat; human audio review and physical microphone qualification are pending. Visible canonical advice is retained and no refund claim was observed.

Default direct-MCP migration remains source-only with network/TLS and joined evaluation gates pending. RC startup explicitly uses the shipped banking Service in process and direct OpenRouter; its success must not be relabeled as network-MCP or native-flow deployment.

Claims p50 21 ms/p95 23 ms while the committed 50-customer lookup manifest is 38.6/51.2 ms. The intervening documentation-only commit corrects this; it does not change the reviewed source or test outcomes.

Full router/public replay was not reexecuted because this environment lacks sklearn. Declared requirements exist; no packages were installed and no external calls were made. Router implementation, frozen data/provenance and committed replay results were inspected.

comparison_quality.router: Meaningful same-workload comparison: 94/120 TF-IDF versus 70/120 keywords, paired 20-point gain with 95% bootstrap interval 10-30 points. Human-required misses 3/30 versus 13/30; abstention lowers this to 1/30 but creates 52 unnecessary handoffs/90. Labels are synthetic and unadjudicated; post-error uncertainty replay is honestly disclosed.
comparison_quality.luna: Frozen mechanically derived oracle and independently replayed baseline are strong correctness/provenance controls. Model and baseline both score 100/100; ten request texts repeated with changed facts are mainly a capacity/boundary workload, not 100 diverse language cases or measured added utility.
comparison_quality.customer: n=3 across revisions with 2/3 agent-screened useful replies; original Portuguese selected-context failure is retained, and later n=1 host fallback is not merged into a new uniform benchmark. CPU baseline and network replies have unequal timing/task boundaries; no valid causal speedup or ROI comparison.
comparison_quality.commercial: ElevenLabs comparison is useful positioning and explicitly disclaims matched latency, voice quality, cost or capability superiority. Vendor claims were not verified externally in this repository-only review.

useful_improvements: Render transaction merchant/status from typed trusted facts, or validate structured factual claims independently of Markdown; add the reproduced ES/PT plain-text cases to regression coverage.

Complete independent human ES/PT adjudication and create a genuinely untouched semantic holdout; include ASR noise, ambiguous ownership and adversarial paraphrases rather than only repeated templates.
Foreground the R0-R18 core and give judges one current source/runtime map, with voice/team/fleet extensions retaining distinct acceptance labels.
Measure matched task benefit and provider cost against the deterministic baseline; preserve transport completion, accepted generation and fallback as separate outcomes.
Require spoken advice to retain essential receipt/authority caveats, then qualify physical microphone behavior and human audio comprehension.
Restore provider availability and qualify the existing fleet extension under its own original-run and snapshot checks when scope/funding allows; do not rerun it merely to improve this review score.
overall_assessment: Strong, inspectable hackathon core and customer prototype, with unusually good ownership/recovery/data discipline and honest evidence scopes. The main scoring ceilings are a concrete display-grounding defect, unadjudicated/small evaluation samples and unmeasured customer utility. No real-bank requirement is imposed, and infrastructure/provider concurrency does not stand in for customer-fleet acceptance.
